nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Documents the RARS Pong game, its Bitmap Display setup, keyboard MMIO controls, game rules, visual design, and troubleshooting steps.

nodes.name: rars1_6.jar
nodes.summary: Bundled RARS 1.6 simulator archive used to assemble and run the RISC-V Pong program.

nodes.name: main.s
nodes.summary: Implements the complete two-player Pong game for RARS, including MMIO input, game state, rendering, score glyphs, and collision handling.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses RARS-compatible RISC-V pseudo-instructions, saved registers for persistent game state, and memory-mapped display and keyboard addresses.

nodes.name: keyboardtest.s
nodes.summary: Standalone RARS program that polls the keyboard receiver and exits after receiving lowercase W.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Initializes framebuffer, game-state, ball, score, and previous-frame registers before entering the game loop.

nodes.name: game_loop
nodes.summary: Coordinates keyboard polling, full versus incremental rendering, gameplay updates, win checks, and software frame pacing.

nodes.name: read_keyboard
nodes.summary: Polls RARS receiver MMIO and maps Space, P, W/S, and I/K input to start, pause, and paddle actions.

nodes.name: move_paddles
nodes.summary: Clamps both paddle top rows so the eight-cell paddles remain inside the 32-row court.

nodes.name: move_ball
nodes.summary: Updates diagonal ball movement, wall and paddle bounces, scoring, serve resets, and redraw requests.

nodes.name: draw_frame
nodes.summary: Performs a complete court redraw for state transitions, drawing the colored background, dashed divider, paddles, ball, scoreboard, and status text.

nodes.name: draw_dynamic_frame
nodes.summary: Redraws only previous and current moving cells during play to reduce display jitter while restoring divider dashes under the ball.

nodes.name: draw_glyph
nodes.summary: Renders a five-by-seven black bitmap glyph at a logical framebuffer position using the glyph row table.

nodes.name: draw_status
nodes.summary: Draws the ready-screen instructions or pause label according to the current game state.

nodes.name: draw_word
nodes.summary: Iterates over a glyph-index array and places evenly spaced status characters on the Bitmap Display.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Initializes keyboard receiver addresses, waits for lowercase W, and exits when it is received.
